Synopsis:
    UEFA is opposing FIFA subsidiaries' attempt to intervene in a Manhattan federal court proceeding where UEFA seeks discovery (via Section 1782) from Thrive Capital and founder Joshua Kushner regarding FIFA's now-abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise deal — a plan to sell permanent commercial rights stakes in World Cup events to private investors. UEFA is building a potential Swiss criminal complaint against FIFA President Infantino for alleged criminal mismanagement. The subsidiaries' intervention bid is characterized by UEFA as procedurally improper, as neither FIFA nor Infantino directly joined the case. The court has yet to rule on both matters.
